coastal.title: Nanaimo, B.C., takes steps to buy public art to commemorate city's lost Chinatowns
coastal.description: The creator of a public art installation that commemorates Nanaimo, B.C.'s former Chinatowns says she's pleased the city has taken steps towards purchasing the piece as part of its permanent collection.

coastal.title: Investigators called in after multiple fires ignite in wildfire-ravaged Boston Bar
coastal.description: A spokesperson with the Fraser Valley Regional District would not say how many fires were burning or if a suspected arsonist is at work.

coastal.title: Wildfire north of Sooke, B.C., burning out of control
coastal.description: The Mount Jack Wildfire on Southern Vancouver Island is still classified as out of control by the B.C. Wildfire Services. It was discovered on Sept. 20 and has grown to at least 210 hectares in size. Part of The Galloping Goose Trail has been closed as precaution.

kamloops.title: Kamloops man finds rare mastodon tooth on B.C. Interior lakeshore
kamloops.description: A man from Kamloops, B.C., has unearthed a prehistoric fossil, marking only the third such discovery in British Columbia.

kamloops.title: Alcohol likely a factor in bridge crash that killed 2 in Kelowna, say RCMP
kamloops.description: RCMP say alcohol was likely a factor after two people died in a Tuesday morning crash on the William R. Bennett Bridge connecting Kelowna and West Kelowna.

kamloops.title: Paddleboarder missing on Okanagan Lake after summer marked by drownings
kamloops.description: RCMP say that just before 7 p.m. PT on Tuesday, they were notified of a pair of paddleboarders "in distress" between Fintry Provincial Park and Carr's Landing. While a woman was rescued by emergency responders in a fire rescue boat, the man she was with could not be found.

prince-george.title: Outgoing Prince George city council delays major decision on new hockey rink, performing arts centre
prince-george.description: Prince George city council has delayed a major decision on next steps for a new downtown hockey rink and performing arts centre until after the municipal election.

all.title: ‘God cleaned the slate’: Ashes pave the road to recovery after B.C. wildfires
all.description: Joel Patan says his "life is ashes" now, as he sifts the ruins of his home that was incinerated last month, along with most structures in the small community of Faulder.
